title: Sign-in for the task app
intro: Answer the first question and watch the others react. The agent can also change this round while you answer.

rules.reason: you chose sign-in by email link, so there is no password to recover

questions.title: How do people sign in?

options.label: Email and password
options.then: We build the password form and the recovery flow.

options.label: Single sign-on only
options.then: Works only for teams with an identity provider.

questions.title: How do people recover a forgotten password?
questions.why: Only matters when there is a password.

questions.title: Where do sessions live?
questions.why: It sets how long a user stays signed in.

options.label: A guest account
options.then: Anyone can try the app without signing in.

questions.why: It goes into the page title.
